evidence: Required empirical reward ordering remains unmeasured. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (Runtime and model evidence) and qc/README.md (Runtime evidence) require a hash-bound reward_ranking_is_monotone runtime record; runtime-evidence.json is absent in this run. Static analysis supports componentwise monotonicity: frozen task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11 has zero-weight render/constraints gates, positive 0.6/0.2/0.2 dimension weights and functional floor 0.05; task/tests/tools/score.py:40-48 computes the positive weighted mean and only suppresses reward below gates/floor. The scorer is byte-identical to the frozen template. All parsed criterion weights are positive (functional 86 criteria, total 45; polish 14, total 9; visual 6, total 6). Thus increasing any fixed scored component cannot lower final reward, but that is not evidence that the configured judge assigns app-level scores in the right order. The negative-control challenge is partly supported: task/tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-26 deliberately permits a working pending-create app while keeping approvals separately scored; local/gate-witness/results.json:15-24 records that dead_approval satisfies the minimal saved-record observations, whereas :26-34 records no_op_create does not. Its :2 explicitly says no judge score. task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:326,335,380 requires successful approval controls before refusal/absence credit, and functional/prompt.md:9 preserves independent observed outcomes. local/coverage-witness/results.json:20-31 records a stale_grant_prices variant whose offer prices remain correct but replacement grant prices fail; :34-45 records forged_revision_role failing Auditor refusal. The file explicitly says no browser/LLM grade or reward prediction (:2). These finite observations do not show either variant scores below the golden. A conforming alternative with different routes, labels, money/date representations and detail layout is explicitly accepted by constraints/judge.toml:24-25 and functional/prompt.md:11, so no definite source-level gate inversion was established in this bounded row review. Verified SHA256 against the current raw evidence index for cited primary artifacts: gate-witness/results.json=fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75; coverage-witness/results.json=ec990e9e16cb0f3fa2a744265e08041c1ed2b2d39333bbbbdf3de20bb7a31e94. Also verified current cited task instruction, scoring policy, scorer, both gate criteria, all three scored criterion files and functional prompt against indexed matching_source_files. No provider execution or new Docker run was performed. No measured ranking, Oracle, model or portal score is claimed.
counterexample: Unresolved empirical challenge, not an observed reward inversion: compare the complete golden with the same app modified to retain stale replacement-grant prices, or to permit forged Auditor revisions, while preserving its other behavior and appearance. Those weaker variants have measured local behavior defects but no configured reward scores. Also compare a conforming alternative using different labels/routes/date formatting; the rubric allows these alternatives, but no configured comparison establishes their ranking.
suggested_fix: When provider execution is authorized, run the unchanged configured verifier on the complete app and controlled weaker variants, retain per-criterion and final rewards, investigate any inversion, and add genuine input-hash-bound reward_ranking_is_monotone runtime evidence with raw command/log hashes; preserve the shared scoring policy.
